description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeEducationService within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to access and set the EmployeeEducationDao data access object. It is part of the PIM (Personal Information Management) plugin's service layer, handling business logic related to employee education data.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing employee education data interactions.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeEducationDao object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeEducationDao object, allowing dependency injection.
